extras: Requires Pandoc 3.6.4 or later. The publishing token is stored in Obsidian's keychain.
intentEvidence: Publish a note to your website over Micropub, with its links turned into real citations.
problem: Users need a way to publish their detailed Obsidian notes to a public website while ensuring internal links and citations resolve correctly.

relations.evidence: Both plugins read a note with the same code, so a note reads the same on your site as in the file you send your supervisor.
Give both plugins the same Bibliography and Citation style, and a post and a talk cite the same way.

summary: A publishing tool that converts Obsidian notes into posts for Micropub, automatically transforming internal links into real citations and stripping Obsidian-specific metadata.
